text: The Corporations Nominating Panel will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the CreateTO Board. The Corporations Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend two candidates, including a Chair, to City Council for appointment.
The Corporations Nominating Panel on September 22, 2025, deferred consideration of Item NC22.1 to the October 24, 2025, meeting of the Corporations Nominating Panel.
